**Narrative 1.0.5** — a free, non-profit tool to build, map and rearrange stories, in English, Português, Español and Français. All your data is stored only on your computer; the app collects no data and no analytics.

The app opens Narrative and keeps itself up to date from https://hvs87.github.io/narrative/ (it works offline after the first start).

**New in 1.0.5:** Dragging an empty space on the board with the mouse moves it around; in a Scene’s details, going to the next or previous Scene slides sideways without flickering, and on a touch screen a sideways swipe does it (along the Narrative Order). (1.0.4 brought details beside the board, filters, views and zoom, search and shortcuts, main Locations, import and a renewed tour.)

| System | File |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | `Narrative-1.0.5-windows-setup.exe` (installer) or `Narrative-1.0.5-windows-portable.exe` (no installation) |
| **macOS** (Intel and Apple silicon) | `Narrative-1.0.5-mac.dmg` |
| **Linux** | `Narrative-1.0.5-linux-x86_64.AppImage` (make it executable and run it) or `.tar.gz` |

The files are not code-signed. **Windows:** on the first start, choose "More info" › "Run anyway". **macOS:** right-click (or Control-click) the app › "Open", then "Open" again; if macOS says the app is damaged, run `xattr -cr /Applications/Narrative.app` in Terminal.

---

**PT:** novidades da 1.0.5: Arrastar um espaço vazio do quadro com o rato desloca-o; na ficha da Cena, a passagem para a Cena seguinte ou anterior desliza de lado, sem piscar, e num ecrã tátil basta deslizar o dedo para o lado (pela Ordem Narrativa). Ferramenta gratuita e sem fins lucrativos, em quatro línguas; todos os dados são unicamente gravados no seu computador. Windows: «Mais informações» › «Executar mesmo assim». macOS: botão direito › «Abrir». Linux: torne o AppImage executável e abra-o.
